relevance_note: Single case report of a PSTPIP1 variant carrier with PAPA syndrome: 'PSTPIP1 gene sequencing, which revealed heterozygosity for a known pathogenic mutation (c.688G>A, p.A230T)'.
method_note: Read by hand; output assembled with a short Python script, no table transcription (the paper has no tables). One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). Age at onset taken from the first symptom (recurrent infections since 1 year of age); age at referral (12 years) is not recorded as age at diagnosis or last evaluation because the paper does not state either. Elevated inflammatory markers: the paper says 'minimal to no elevation in acute phase reactants' during the elbow episodes and 'normal inflammatory markers' at 9 years; the excluded row is kept for the 9-year episode only and the checklist item left 'not reported' because minimal elevation is not ruled out. Neutropenia left 'not reported' although WBC and differential were 'normal'. Recurrent infections checklist set observed from recurrent purulent otitis media; the authors regard the later 'presumed' infections (cellulitis, abscesses, septic arthritis) as sterile, recorded as abscesses/arthritis/osteomyelitis. No contradictions found otherwise.
